title: Reconcile historical P112 b5 callers against six pinned contracts
body:
Six fixed published contracts account for all 38 original TWOSIDE `(5,5)` survivors and 76 of 77 original `(5,6)` survivors. Add a source-bound conditional composition certificate, separate application checker and exact quotient interface for the sole inventory-uncertified profile `2^5,6,7^5`. These are nested historical cells, not115 distinct profiles or a complete current C5 frontier.

The remaining interface has 11 independent pieces, code-intersection dimension exactly5, quotient dimension6 and one common support cap 30 from the six small pieces. All 462 six-piece subsets have individual-capacity sum at least 30; this does not lower-bound the actual support union. Five independent residual-rank-seven directions are required. A separately verified common30 span bound below 5 would complete this fixed inventory; concurrent geometry work owns that new theorem.

The six contracts are PR[3262](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3262) (rank 6/common29), PR[3283](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3283) (rank 5/common47), PR[3205](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3205) (six support20 endpoints/common30), PR[3154](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3154)'s completed beta7p2 contract via PR[3289](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3289), and pending PR[3931](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3931)/[3960](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3960) common23/common24. The contribution is exact source binding and caller composition, with earlier exclusions credited rather than claimed anew. The two pending proof texts are retained byte-for-byte with head/hash provenance, so cold replay needs no foreign pending Git objects.

Evidence at `ba0349b99eb78f9476d20352cb6bfa9bbe8984e3`:

- Original and separately written filters agree across7,798 and 12,166 multisets. Independent small-first/subset enumeration checks all 690 rule/row combinations, every indexed witness, assignment count and capacity minimum.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes all three commands. Boundary controls cover strict excess, deletion charges and the common-cut quantifier; actual optimized CLI mutations reject changed source, source usage and surviving code dimension.
- All 22 package/input files match the publication commit; declared source-history check passes. The committed export passes integrity checking and all three direct commands in a read-only Git-free replay with an empty executable search path. All 23 export files, including export metadata, remain unchanged.
- Parent read-only proof/code review found no objection to the deletion, restriction, quotient and beta7p2 transfers. This is same-session automated review, not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-b5-caller-inventory
```

Canonical main refreshed at publication remains `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Latest overlap snapshot covered 673 open PR bodies at 07:30:28UTC and rendered C5/start/handoff/active-board pages, with partial Discussion coverage. No collision found for this scoped inventory.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR[3154](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3154); Nick Petalas/PR[3205](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3205)/[3262](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3262)/[3283](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3283) and the PR[3282](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3282)/[3289](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3289) composition framework; Chris R/Clear1nsight with Codex for PR[3931](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3931)/[3960](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3960); joaqcoo and the retained E8/P112 lineage. New work by Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

Inherited geometric contracts, capacities, distance, characteristic-zero arguments and original decoder reduction remain conditional inputs. Their heavy suites, complete C5, physical supplier and selected cold replay were not run here. No new geometric theorem, full decoder floor, supplier admission, kappa change or human/formal acceptance is claimed. One isolated opt-in package; no shared code or frozen predecessor edits.


Task: complex-rank-shape-decoder, changed scope to source-bound historical caller reconciliation. PROOF.md and TASK.json contain the exact scope, inherited obligations and open next questions. The concurrently established common30 theorem is a separate contribution; it is not silently treated as an accepted input here.


Concurrent completion: [PR3973](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3973), exact head1e77152b14dd94ca3f99ce1afba280ba13225d9c, separately proves common30 span at most 3 and excludes the sole row outside this fixed six-contract inventory. Combining its stated theorem with this package’s quotient transfer conditionally covers all 77 historical (5,6) profiles, and all 38 nested (5,5) profiles. This does not claim full current C5. The six-rule executable inventory is frozen at 38/38 and 76/77; the additional dependency is explicit. The independent common24 audit is [PR #3971](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3971).
